bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
test "$(docker inspect deploy-postgres-1 --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 70
rooms=$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -At -c "SELECT count(*) FROM room_posts WHERE title='【検証】ROOM公開同期テスト' AND created_at>NOW()-INTERVAL '24 hours' AND status='finished'")
test "$rooms" = 1 || exit 71
deliveries=$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -At -c "SELECT count(*) FROM room_posts r JOIN announcement_posts a ON a.room_id=r.room_id JOIN posting_deliveries d ON d.source_type='announcement' AND d.source_id=a.announcement_id::text WHERE r.title='【検証】ROOM公開同期テスト' AND r.created_at>NOW()-INTERVAL '24 hours' AND d.status='sent' AND d.telegram_message_id IS NOT NULL")
test "$deliveries" -ge 1 && test "$deliveries" -le 2 || exit 72
all_delivery=$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -At -c "SELECT count(*) FROM room_posts r JOIN announcement_posts a ON a.room_id=r.room_id JOIN posting_deliveries d ON d.source_type='announcement' AND d.source_id=a.announcement_id::text WHERE r.title='【検証】ROOM公開同期テスト' AND r.created_at>NOW()-INTERVAL '24 hours'")
test "$all_delivery" = "$deliveries" || exit 73
confirmed=$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -At -c "SELECT count(*) FROM room_posts r JOIN room_source_events e ON e.room_id=r.room_id AND e.kind='finished' JOIN room_status_message_edits q ON q.room_event_id=e.event_id WHERE r.title='【検証】ROOM公開同期テスト' AND r.created_at>NOW()-INTERVAL '24 hours' AND q.state='confirmed'")
test "$confirmed" = "$deliveries" || exit 74
stale=$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -At -c "SELECT count(*) FROM room_posts r JOIN room_source_events e ON e.room_id=r.room_id AND e.kind='finished' JOIN room_status_message_edits q ON q.room_event_id=e.event_id WHERE r.title='【検証】ROOM公開同期テスト' AND r.created_at>NOW()-INTERVAL '24 hours' AND q.state<>'confirmed'")
test "$stale" = 0 || exit 75
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 76
echo ROOM_PUBLIC_FINAL_STATE=FINISHED
echo ROOM_PUBLIC_DELIVERY_COUNT="$deliveries"
echo ROOM_PUBLIC_FINISHED_EDIT_COUNT="$confirmed"
echo ROOM_PUBLIC_ALL_DELIVERIES_CONFIRMED=PASS
